purpose: Use post-coverage scans of strong physical targets as a control experiment for namespace abundance and ingest useful security, measurement-standard, public-statistics, research-mapping and material-custody sources without strengthening P1/P2 from metadata density.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, material record or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Publisher/preprint copies, NVD/vendor mirrors, national adoptions of the same IEC text and database aliases for the same underlying source are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: CVE IDs, rule IDs, bug IDs, standard numbers, article IDs, catalog IDs and dataset IDs may be useful to Worldshepherd but carry zero automatic Glob evidence and never strengthen an existing P1/P2 solely through repeated digit occurrence.

sources.title: CVE-2025-60705 — Windows CSC Service local privilege escalation
sources.note: Use as an access-control/elevation test case for Windows-connected deployments. 60705 is the CVE identifier and is independent of the Sr I physical value near 60705 cm^-1.

sources.title: Snort rule 1:60705 — Windows privilege-escalation attempt detection
sources.note: Use as a detection-engineering precedent linking exploit behavior to explicit network rules and false-positive review. 60705 is a rule identifier.

sources.title: IEC 60705:2024 — Household microwave ovens: methods for measuring performance
sources.note: Use the standard's defined performance characteristics and measurement methods as a reference for repeatable RF/microwave power and energy-consumption test design. 60705 is the standard number.

sources.title: CVE-2025-60057 — DJ Rainflow local file inclusion
sources.note: Use as a file-include/path-control security test case. 60057 is the CVE identifier and is independent of the Sr I physical value near 60057 cm^-1.

sources.title: Decoding the Digital Pulse: Bibliometric Analysis of 25 Years in Digital Health Research Through the Journal of Medical Internet Research
sources.note: Use bibliometric/network-analysis methods as a precedent for mapping Worldshepherd's own literature and source-domain evolution. 60057 is the article identifier.

sources.title: Expenditure on internal R&D by type of administration
sources.authority: Spain datos.gob.es / Instituto Nacional de Estadistica
sources.note: Use as a public R&D-investment time-series source and data-ingestion/control dataset. 60397 is the dataset API identifier and is independent of Pb III spectroscopy.

sources.title: ATCC 93709 — yWXD3439 human clone
sources.note: Use certificate, biosafety, cross-reference and permitted-use metadata as another governed research-material custody pattern. 93709 is the catalog identifier and is independent of the Mo III physical level near 93709 cm^-1.

information_updates.finding: Targets already carrying strong physical evidence can also be dense in unrelated CVE, standard, bug, rule, article, catalog and dataset namespaces. The Sr I pair 60057/60705 and physical P1 states 60397/93709 provide direct examples.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This supports treating identifier multiplicity and physical evidence as separate variables; it neither strengthens nor weakens the underlying P1/P2 relations by itself.

information_updates.finding: IEC 60705 demonstrates a useful test-governance pattern: define performance characteristics, operating conditions, measurement procedures and energy/power metrics before comparing devices. The same structure can inform Worldshepherd RF and hardware test plans even outside household-appliance scope.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Method-structure transfer only; Worldshepherd hardware is not claimed compliant with IEC 60705.

information_updates.finding: Bibliometric and network-analysis methods from the 25-year JMIR study can be adapted to quantify Worldshepherd source-domain concentration, collaboration clusters, topic drift and evidence-corpus evolution over time.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This is a methodological reuse proposal, not a claim that health-research network structure generalizes unchanged to Worldshepherd.

next_actions: Use the multiplicity analyzer to compare record and namespace depth for P1/P2 targets versus nonphysical controls without converting the comparison into evidence until a preregistered statistical test is specified.
Continue scanning sparse targets and add useful sources from any domain, including standards, cybersecurity, software, logistics, manufacturing, operations, economics and biological custody.
Continue W II and Sr I same-system topology/relational verification independently from metadata abundance.
Maintain fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls for physical-evidence promotion.
